item.title: VortexKV: a multithreaded key-value store in C++20
item.description: How a specialized, shared-nothing KV store hits 9.9M pipelined GETs/sec — 3.7× faster than Dragonfly — and the engineering decisions behind it.

item.title: About
item.description:
I’m Shashank Joshi, a C++ engineer with 5 years of experience building performance-sensitive systems.

I like working close to the metal — data structures, cache behaviour, lock-free concurrency, and squeezing throughput out of multi-core machines. The posts on this site walk through projects I’ve built from scratch and the decisions behind them.

I’m currently open to C++ roles. The best way to reach me is by email at shashankjoshi2602@gmail.com, or on GitHub and LinkedIn.
